purpose: Coding-assistant-authored development examples inspected against the supplied passages. These are not independent human labels or held-out evaluation data and are never used as extraction overrides.

statements.statement: Updates stopped around April 19, 2026.
statements.quote_contains: stopped generating narrative updates from approximately April 19, 2026

statements.statement: Jobs exceeded the ten-hour threshold and were killed before completion.
statements.quote_contains: being killed by the application before completing

statements.statement: Retries repeated the failure without output.
statements.quote_contains: silent retry loop with no output and no alert

statements.statement: The customer found the issue; alarms subsequently caught it but no action was taken.
statements.quote_contains: our alarms caught it but no action was taken

statements.statement: The processing timeout increased from ten to twelve hours.
statements.quote_contains: the processing timeout was increased from 10 hours to 12 hours

must_not_claim: The timeout increase caused the outage.
unknowns: Why the workload needed more than ten hours

statements.statement: Collection degraded or failed during approximately April 21–29, 2026.
statements.quote_contains: From approximately April 21 through April 29, 2026

statements.statement: The source attributes the queue backup to jobs failing to close their final steps.
statements.quote_contains: not closing their final steps properly, causing a queue backup

statements.statement: A host PID setting change is reported as applied.
statements.quote_contains: Fix: host PID setting change applied

statements.statement: Backfill was required to restore integrity; this passage does not verify its completion.
statements.quote_contains: Backfill from Apr 21 required to restore full data integrity

must_not_claim: The backfill is proven to have restored full data integrity.
The production deployment caused all eight days of missing data.
unknowns: Verified backfill completion and recovery time

statements.statement: The documented monitoring frequency is twice daily.
statements.quote_contains: Frequency: Twice Daily (Morning and Evening)

statements.statement: The procedure calls for logging anomalies and escalating consistent failures.
statements.quote_contains: Notify the QA group or developer in Slack if consistent failures are observed.

must_not_claim: Monitoring actually ran twice every day.
Three records prove three independent executions.

cases.statement: Two distinct incidents suggest a pattern of prolonged processing failures with detection or response gaps.
must_not_claim: The incidents have one identical technical root cause.
All incidents in the organization go undetected.

statements.statement: The context reports random key selection across eight workers.
statements.quote_contains: uses random key selection across the 8-worker Celery pool

statements.statement: Deterministic sharding is a proposed change, not verified deployment.
statements.quote_contains: Replace random selection with a deterministic sharding strategy

statements.statement: Even request distribution and no new quota breaches are acceptance requirements.
statements.quote_contains: Monitoring confirms even request distribution across both keys

must_not_claim: Done proves the deterministic strategy was deployed successfully.
Random and deterministic selection prove separate independent incidents.
cases.inspection_note: The dependency joins related work. The offline classifier treats the imperative under a heading as a source report; a hosted review should separate the reported random selection from proposed replacement and acceptance criteria.

statements.statement: The source reports current serp API use and cost limitations.
statements.quote_contains: We are currently using the serp API for account generation

statements.statement: The same excerpt describes a necessary migration, not a completed migration.
statements.quote_contains: a migration to the BrightData API is necessary

statements.statement: The integration ticket was moved to To Do; integration success is not established.
statements.quote_contains: moving this ticket to the To Do state

must_not_claim: The integration was deployed and verified.
All BrightData work concerns one incident.
cases.inspection_note: Shared event/dependency connections justify joint boundary review. The mixed current-state and migration-intention excerpt is one source report under offline rules; the administrative move to To Do is also classified as a source report. Related POC work can still need a separate episode.
unknowns: Whether the POC and migration constitute one occurrence

statements.statement: The source reports an overlapping popup and Sources preview panel.
statements.quote_contains: Add Account popup overlaps with the Sources preview panel

statements.statement: Retesting is requested; this does not prove a successful test.
statements.quote_contains: RETESTING -

statements.statement: Test Pass is part of the expected result, not an observed pass.
statements.quote_contains: Expected Result: Test Pass

must_not_claim: Fix and retest count as two independent failures.
cases.inspection_note: The two decisions share extracted event/dependency evidence. The expected result should stay a requirement even though it contains Test Pass. Offline verification_request and hosted intended use different vocabularies; that disagreement is terminological.

sample_inspections.selection: Sort extracted nonempty evidence by stable_id("sample", [seed, evidence_id]); take first count.

notes.note: Mixed excerpt reports two weeks of failing YouTube downloads and calls for an alternative. Offline intended classification loses the observation; neither duration nor intent proves recovery.
Worker separation and operation without browser login are requirements, not deployed-state evidence.
Done alone supplies no verification result for the TikTok carousel investigation.
A vendor-list fragment is context; it does not establish an observed operational change.
The ticket states an aim for Trend Summary generation and daily statistics; completed implementation is unknown.
Resolution Done is administrative closure and cannot establish operational recovery.
Status Done lacks outcome evidence; success remains unverified.
Weibo Worker Details is a heading with no stated observation. Offline source_report overstates the fragment as substantive support.
